title: John Oliver Mocks Trump’s Ballroom Plans (Again) and His Contradictory Claims Over the Reflecting Pool Upgrades
summary: "If you are a president who'd rather focus on ballroom construction and pool maintenance than the crucial work of actually running a country, then ... you are not a smart f***ing person," the 'Last Week Tonight' host said, throwing Trump's own words back at him.
tags: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver
